verdict.rationale: Grafana Cloud's Adaptive Telemetry suite is documented as automatically identifying valuable telemetry and aggregating/dropping the rest to cut costs up to 80% (grafana-docs-14, grafana-docs-21, grafana-docs-28, grafana-docs-34), which addresses the cost/volume-management intent, but this is an automated aggregation feature rather than developer-controlled sampling rates or explicit retention-tier configuration for traces/logs. No evidence describes granular developer-facing controls for trace sampling rates or per-tier log/trace retention settings. Missing for 10: explicit trace sampling rate configuration, developer-managed retention tier settings, documentation showing manual/deliberate control rather than automatic aggregation.
